name: ripgrep
description: Line-oriented search tool combining grep speed with user-friendly defaults (Rust CLI)
questions: Q1. Search for whole-word case-insensitive occurrences of 'config' in Rust files only. Show the exact rg command, run it, and paste the first 5 lines.
